notes.title: Small Patch Version 1.01 Released!
notes.content:
This new version fixes and tweaks a few things in the game due to player feedback:

Fixed an issue in the Tavern where you couldn't leave unless you clicked on a certain spot. This has now been fixed.

Tweaked loot awards to be slightly more generous in terms of potions and armor.

Tweaked random encounters to be around 2-3% less.

Enjoy!

Derek
